title: Apollyon, the World's End
description: Apollyon has the Aspect of Ravening: Spirit animals multiply, then rise as one devouring chorus.

title: Apollyon, the End of Causality
description: Apollyon has the Aspect of Catastrophe: Each event births another, portents of the coming storm.

title: Apollyon, the Doom of Humanity
description: Apollyon has the Aspect of Slaughter: Warriors gather in ranks and strike before mercy.

title: Apollyon, the Butcher
description: Apollyon has the Aspect of Hunger: Every sacrifice feeds the survivors.

title: Apollyon, the Last Word
description: Apollyon has the Aspect of Haunting: An ethereal host returns endlessly.

title: Apollyon, the Broken Cycle
description: Apollyon has the Aspect of Damnation: Broken souls wind through death's river.

title: Apollyon, the Keeper of Names
description: Apollyon has the Aspect of Suffering: The discarded become omens of the coming calamity.

title: Apollyon, Sovereign of the Void
description: Apollyon has the Aspect of Oblivion: The onrushing void swells to infinity.

title: Apollyon, the Unplaceable
description: Apollyon has the Aspect of Violation: Striking with precision dissolves every blocker.

title: Apollyon, the Herald of Revelation
description: Apollyon has the Aspect of Frenzy: Warriors awaken into the final rapture.
